prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent walking sprite atlas for a WPF desktop dog.
Reference roles: image1 right-eight-phase-guide.png is the motion pose reference, eight consecutive video frames in chronological row-major order. image2 pet.jpg and image3 three-view reference are CHARACTER IDENTITY and fur/face references, not motion references.
Create exactly EIGHT full-body bichon dog sprites in a precisely spaced 4 column x 2 row atlas, all walking RIGHT, corresponding ONE TO ONE to the eight video pose panels. Output 1536x1024 RGBA with genuinely transparent empty background, generous transparent gutters, no text or ground/shadow. Each dog same scale, same camera, same shoulder/hip position and paw ground line within its cell.
Retain original photo's rounded white curly bichon head, floppy fur-covered ears, short black muzzle/nose, dark eyes, red floral collar with small round golden bell, white curled tail, realistic soft detailed fur matching existing pet. Compact natural dog proportions, not a toy with huge spherical head. Head faces right with slight three-quarter view and a calm slightly open mouth, same orientation/expression across ALL frames; do not copy the video dog's head turning or humans/leash/background.
CRITICAL MOTION: faithfully translate the eight reference panels' LEG positions into this character. In panels1-2 the nearest front paw reaches down then bears weight, panels3-4 the opposite forepaw swings forward as the nearest retreats, panels5-6 opposite forepaw plants and bears weight, panels7-8 nearest forepaw bends and swings forward again. Rear paws must follow the VIDEO: clear alternating bend/recovery, hind paw pushes back then folds forward under belly then plants. Keep the hips attached to a stable body, natural knee and hock articulation concealed by fur. Paws lift only slightly off the floor, no high marching, no straight rigid rear legs, no hovering paw held identical across the whole row. Full four legs where not anatomically occluded, no doubled/fused paws. Leg silhouette must visibly change every phase, with distinct planted, passing, and reaching poses. Torso remains almost level; no body squash, no exaggerated bobbing. Final frame leads smoothly into first without repeated endpoint.
This is an actual continuous eight-phase walking animation, not eight portraits of a static walking pose. No rearrangement of phases. Each dog completely inside its own equal-size cell with wide clear alpha gaps.

Use case: background-extraction / identity-preserve.
EDIT TARGET: first image four-key-pose-guide.png, a 2x2 panel of four frames from the user's dog walking video. CHARACTER DETAIL reference second image pet.jpg.
Create a clean 2x2 sprite atlas from these exact FOUR VIDEO DOG POSES. Precisely preserve EACH corresponding video panel's leg positions, joint angles, paw contacts, silhouette, body proportions and right-facing viewing angle. Especially hind leg positions: pose1 hind legs relatively upright, pose2 near hind paw planted toward rear, pose3 near hind leg bends and begins recovery, pose4 near hind paw swings forward underneath belly and far rear leg remains grounded. Do NOT replace the four different video poses with a generic repeated striding stance.
Remove absolutely all humans, leash, pavement, labels and backgrounds from every panel and leave real zero-alpha transparency everywhere outside the dogs. No added shadow, glow, gray wash, checkerboard or background gradient. Four full uncut dogs centered in equal 768x512 cells, output1536x1024. Generous empty gutters.
Render the video dog with clean photorealistic soft white curly bichon fur and the same dog face proportions as pet.jpg, add its red floral collar and small golden round bell. Keep face facing RIGHT and calm and consistent, mouth slightly open. Keep natural compact torso from VIDEO, head size consistent with VIDEO, not enlarged cartoon head. Maintain faithful paw pose copying and all four canine legs where visible. Dog1 and dog4 must have visibly DIFFERENT nearest hind paw x-position; dog2 and dog4 must have different support/swing rear-leg phases. Same scale, level torso, same shoulder/hip position in all4 cells, hind joints naturally flexing, tiny paw clearance. Sharpen video fur faithfully, don't invent exaggerated motion. These are four chronological KEYFRAMES of walking, not four static portraits.
Leg fidelity to video is highest priority. Preserve true generated alpha.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit the attached contact sheet. Remove the background of all EIGHT real bichon dogs from these video frames. This is a FRAME EXTRACTION job, not creating new imagined dog poses.
Output the same 4-column x 2-row contact sheet, with exactly the eight ORIGINAL dog bodies from each respective panel in original chronological order. Preserve the specific body, legs, paw locations, tail, fur and face of EACH ORIGINAL FRAME. Do not copy one dog across the eight cells. DO NOT reinterpret poses, do not invent a new generic gait, do not change the leg positions. The entire purpose is to faithfully retain the visible small differences in hind-leg swing from frame to frame.
Remove labels, human shoes/legs, pavement, shadows, leash, all environmental pixels. Outside each dog use actual zero-alpha transparency with clean soft fur edges, no background and no gray/white field. Keep each whole dog fully inside its panel with empty gutter; translate whole bodies slightly for padding if necessary. Moderate sharpening of compressed fur only, preserving all silhouette contours and paw orientations. Same underlying photographed dog remains unchanged. No new collar, accessories or cartoon styling. Transparent 1536x1024 PNG, four columns, two rows, no text. Exact input poses are the overriding constraint.

Edit the eight-dog transparent atlas (image1), keeping the eight DISTINCT leg poses in their existing row-major order. Preserve each dog's body/legs and exact paw positions from its OWN panel; never copy a pose to another panel. This is a narrow character/detail cleanup, not new motion creation.
Add the reference photograph's red floral collar and small round gold bell to ALL eight dogs. Improve white curly fur to match photo2 without changing silhouettes or proportions. Neutral soft white lighting consistently in all panels, white fur instead of yellow video tint. Preserve small natural head and body from image1; keep head facing right at same angle and height in all eight cells, no head turning. Tail size remains constant, allow tiny gentle sway, avoid giant tail growth in last panels.
All 8 poses show the same individual dog. Keep each dog's nearest and far hind-paw positions EXACTLY as original corresponding panel. Maintain natural low paw lift, compact stride, canine flexed knees/hocks. The silhouette of legs is already motion reference. Clean separation of anatomically occluded paws without adding limbs. 
Output1536x1024 transparent PNG, EXACT evenly spaced4 columns x2rows, each complete dog inside a384x512cell with at least32pixels empty gutters on BOTH sides, same body scale. No dog fur spills into other cells. No text, shadows, gradients, floor, humans or leash. All outside-dog pixels actual alpha zero. Same clean alpha extraction with fur edges. No part masks, no composite ghosts.

Create LEFT-FACING counterpart of the provided transparent right-walking sprite atlas. Edit EACH individual dog within its OWN CELL so it faces LEFT. Keep the eight chronological phases at the SAME cell indices (top row0,1,2,3 bottom4,5,6,7). Do not reverse or rearrange the whole atlas.
Preserve the same bichon character, natural compact body, soft white curls, round head, floppy ears, red floral collar and small gold bell. Change viewing direction only, with each pose's anatomy faithfully reversed in place. Head stays left-facing with same slight3/4angle and same size/expression allframes. Four real canine limbs where visible, distinguish planted and bent swing paws, no fused legs.
CRITICAL: keep eight DISTINCT gait poses from input, especially hind-paw sequence: moves backward while grounded, pushes off behind hip, bends under body during recovery then swings forward and plants. Do not hold hind legs in a generic static stride. Every dog's knee/hock and paw positions must reflect its own phase from input, reversed relative to walking direction. Low paw lift, level torso, no jump, no high marching. Same collar/face and fur style, consistent tail volume.
Exactly8 dogs, equal4columns x2rows, transparent1536x1024PNG. Each dog entirely within its384x512cell, at least32pixels clean gutters on BOTH sides; do not spill fur into adjacent cells. Same scale and local shoulder/hip registration and planted-paw baseline per cell. No text, floor, shadows, studio gradient or other objects, truezeroalpha outside silhouettes. The goal is a natural LEFT walking continuous loop, not8identicalposes.

Horizontally flip the ENTIRE provided transparent sprite sheet from left to right as a whole image. Exact horizontal mirror of all existing pixels/poses. Preserve original dogs and all eight distinct leg poses, fur, shapes, alpha, colors, collar and gold bell. Do not redraw or redesign any dog. The leftmost dog becomes the rightmost dog of its row, each dog's head now facing LEFT. Mirror the whole atlas; it is OK and required that columns reverse. Keep the same4x2layout1536x1024. No added objects, no studio scene, transparent background preserved exactly. ONLY horizontal whole-image flipping.

left_note: ImageGen requested whole-atlas flip; generated counterpart is not a byte-exact mirror. Whole-cell chronology restored in packaging. No scripted image flips or body-part warping.
